summary: Narrow treed lane with a house about 8 m away and no stopping signs.
reasons: Building 8 m from kerb at 50 m
No Stopping Any Time signs at the start
No room to pull off the narrow lane

drivers.seclusion: Houses and pools sit within about 8-15 m of the north kerb; the lane runs between private blocks.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed lane under thick canopy with no verge, no parked cars and no visible pull-off.
drivers.convention: No cars parked along it; no sign of overnight stays.

flags: Signs: No Stopping Any Time at the start of the stretch
Slope flat at 40-50 m; the upper part is steep (27% max)
sun_shade: Dense tree cover over most of the section, shade all day.
cannot_judge: Whether the 8 m building is a dwelling (tagged only as yes)

best_section.where: Lower end of the narrow lane south-east of the sign, under heavy tree canopy
